mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with potential for competitive inhibition; praziquantel may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of galantamine, increasing galantamine levels.
action: Monitor for increased galantamine adverse effects (nausea, diarrhea, bradycardia); consider dose adjustment if toxicity occurs; separate administration timing may provide minimal benefit given hepatic metabolism pathways.
